title: Identity Disclosure
description: Homeowner (EE1) shares personal identifying information (PII) with the Home Hub (P1) during account registration. This act of sharing causes a threat because the Hub receives and stores this data, potentially enabling identification of the homeowner.

title: Data Processing for Identification
description: Homeowner (EE1) shares personal identifying information (PII) with the Home Hub (P1) during account registration. This act of sharing causes a threat because the Hub processes this data, potentially enabling identification of the homeowner.

title: Unauthorized Access Attempt
description: Guest User (EE2) enters a temporary access code at the Home Hub (P1). This action causes a privacy threat because the guest's identity is shared with the system, potentially allowing the system to identify or track the guest.
assumptions: The guest is not authenticated or has not been verified by the Home Hub.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the guest's identity is actually shared with the system; the threat arises from the act of sharing, not necessarily the content of the code.

title: Data-Centric Threat: Identity Linking
description: The data flow (DF2) transmits guest identity information (the access code) to the Home Hub (P1). This creates a data-centric threat because the system receives data about the guest (the code) which may be used to link or identify the guest to the system, even if the guest is not authenticated.
assumptions: The access code is transmitted in transit and is not encrypted or obfuscated.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the code is used to identify the guest; the threat arises from the data-centric nature of the transmission.

title: Unauthorized Processing/Storage
description: The Home Hub (P1) receives the guest's access code and processes or stores it. This causes a privacy threat because the system receives data about the guest (the code) which may be used to identify or track the guest, even if the guest is not authenticated.
assumptions: The Home Hub processes or stores the guest's access code without proper authentication or verification.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the Home Hub stores the code; the threat arises from the act of processing/receiving the data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Home Hub
description: The Home Hub (Process P1) shares sensitive motion/door/sensor event data with the Local Event Log (DataStore DS1). If the Home Hub lacks appropriate access controls or encryption, an unauthorized party could access this data, potentially compromising the integrity and confidentiality of the sensor readings.
assumptions: The Home Hub does not enforce strict access controls or encryption on the data it writes to the Local Event Log.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the Home Hub has implemented any security measures for the data written to DS1.

title: Data in Transit
description: The data flow (DF3) carries motion/door/sensor event data between the Home Hub and the Local Event Log. If the data is not encrypted in transit, an attacker could intercept the data, potentially linking or identifying the parties involved.
assumptions: The data flow does not use encryption for the data in transit.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the data flow uses encryption for the data in transit.

title: Unauthorized Access to Local Event Log
description: The Local Event Log (DataStore DS1) receives the motion/door/sensor event data from the Home Hub. If the Local Event Log lacks appropriate access controls or encryption, an unauthorized party could access this data, potentially compromising the integrity and confidentiality of the sensor readings.
assumptions: The Local Event Log does not enforce strict access controls or encryption on the data it receives.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the Local Event Log has implemented any security measures for the data it receives.

title: Unauthorized Access to Uploaded Media
description: The Home Hub (Process P1) shares recorded camera clips with the Cloud Video Storage (DataStore DS2). If the Home Hub lacks appropriate access controls or encryption, an unauthorized party could access the media content.
assumptions: The Home Hub does not enforce strict access controls or encryption on the data being shared.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the Home Hub has implemented any access controls or encryption measures.

title: Data in Transit
description: The recorded camera clips are transmitted between the Home Hub and the Cloud Video Storage. If the data is not encrypted in transit, an attacker could intercept the media content.
assumptions: The data transfer mechanism does not use encryption.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the data transfer uses encryption.

title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Media
description: The Cloud Video Storage (DataStore DS2) receives the uploaded clips. If the storage system lacks appropriate access controls or encryption, an unauthorized party could access the media content.
assumptions: The Cloud Video Storage does not enforce strict access controls or encryption on the data being stored.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the Cloud Video Storage has implemented any access controls or encryption measures.

title: Data Disclosure to Mobile App Backend
description: The Home Hub (Process P1) shares personal motion alert data with the Mobile App Backend (Process P2). This constitutes a Data Disclosure threat as the transfer of personal data across a boundary (P1 to P2) is considered avoidable. The minimality principle is violated if the alert contains unnecessary personal data beyond what is strictly required for the app's functionality.
assumptions: The motion alert is intended for the mobile app backend.

title: Data Disclosure in Transit
description: The data flow (DF5) carries personal motion alert data between the Home Hub and the Mobile App Backend. This represents a Data Disclosure threat at the data-centric level, where the data itself is the medium of transmission. The threat arises from the act of sharing the data in transit, which can be used to link or identify the parties involved.
assumptions: The data flow carries personal motion alert data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Motion Data
description: The mobile app backend (P2) shares motion-detected notification data with the homeowner's phone (EE1). If the backend lacks sufficient authentication or encryption, an attacker could intercept or access this data, potentially linking the homeowner's identity to their motion events.
assumptions: The backend does not implement strong authentication or encryption for this data flow.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the backend has implemented strong authentication or encryption; this is a common vulnerability in unsecured mobile app backends.

title: Data in Transit
description: The motion-detected notification data travels between the backend (P2) and the homeowner's phone (EE1). If the data is not encrypted in transit, an attacker could potentially intercept the data, potentially linking the homeowner's identity to their motion events.
assumptions: The data is not encrypted during transmission.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the data is encrypted during transmission; this is a common vulnerability in unsecured mobile app backends.

title: Unauthorized Access to Data
description: The homeowner's phone (EE1) receives the motion-detected notification data. If the phone lacks sufficient authentication or encryption, an attacker could intercept or access this data, potentially linking the homeowner's identity to their motion events.
assumptions: The phone lacks sufficient authentication or encryption for this data flow.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if the phone has sufficient authentication or encryption; this is a common vulnerability in unsecured mobile apps.

title: Unauthorized Access to Shared Analytics
description: The mobile app backend (P2) shares aggregated device-usage analytics with the cloud analytics vendor (EE3). If the vendor lacks proper access controls or the data is not encrypted in transit, an unauthorized party could access this sensitive data.
assumptions: The vendor does not have strict access controls in place.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if vendor has implemented strict access controls; this is a high-severity risk if controls are absent.

title: Data in Transit
description: The aggregated device-usage analytics are transmitted over the network. If the data is not encrypted or is exposed in metadata, it could be intercepted or linked to specific users.
assumptions: Data is transmitted without encryption or with minimal metadata protection.
uncertainty_note: Assuming standard network transmission without explicit encryption; metadata exposure is a common risk.

title: Unauthorized Processing
description: The cloud analytics vendor (EE3) receives the data and processes it in a way that causes a threat, such as storing it in a way that allows for future unauthorized access or re-identification.
assumptions: The vendor stores the data in a way that enables future unauthorized access or re-identification.
uncertainty_note: Uncertain if vendor's storage practices are secure; this is a high-severity risk if storage is not protected.

title: Violation of storage limitation principle
description: The mobile app backend (Process P2) stores the video clip retrieved from the data store (DS2) for playback. This action may violate the storage limitation principle if the video is retained longer than necessary for the user's viewing session, potentially leading to unnecessary retention of personal data.
assumptions: The video clip is considered personal data under the applicable privacy framework.

title: Insecure storage or insufficient minimization
description: The mobile app backend (Process P2) receives the video clip from the data store (DS2) and processes it for playback. If the backend does not implement appropriate security measures (e.g., encryption, access controls) or data minimization (e.g., deleting the clip after playback), it may cause a privacy threat.
assumptions: The backend's security and minimization practices are not fully verified.
uncertainty_note: Assumptions based on general best practices; specific implementation details are not provided.
